parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The sorting direction. Valid values: DESC, ASC. Default value: DESC.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name.<props="china"> For more information, see [DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>
<props="intl">For more information, see [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the domain group.

- If you do not specify GroupId, the query is performed on all domain names.

- If you set GroupId to 0, an empty result is returned.

- If you set GroupId to -1, the query is performed on the default group. The default group includes domain names that are not assigned to a group.

- If you set GroupId to -2, the query is performed on all domain names.

- If you specify another value for GroupId, the query is performed on the specified group.
  <props="china">For more information, see [DescribeDomainGroups](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaingroups?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>
  <props="intl">For more information, see [DescribeDomainGroups](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaingroups?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: Line
parameters.description:
The DNS resolution line. Default value: **default**.

For more information, see:
<props="china">[Enumeration of DNS resolution lines](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29807.html).</props>

<props="intl">

[Enumeration of DNS resolution lines](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29807.htm)

</props>

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The sorting method. Records are sorted in descending order based on the time they were added.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: **500**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RRKeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword for the host record. The search uses a fuzzy match pattern and is not case-sensitive.

parameters.name: SearchMode
parameters.description:
The search mode. Valid values: LIKE, EXACT, ADVANCED, and **COMBINATION**.

- If you set this parameter to LIKE or EXACT, use the KeyWord parameter. The RRKeyWord, TypeKeyWord, ValueKeyWord, Type, Line, and Status parameters are invalid.

- If you set this parameter to ADVANCED, use the RRKeyWord, TypeKeyWord, ValueKeyWord, Type, Line, and Status parameters. The RRKeyWord and ValueKeyWord parameters support fuzzy matching.

- If you set this parameter to COMBINATION, use the RRKeyWord, TypeKeyWord, ValueKeyWord, Type, Line, and Status parameters. All these parameters support only exact matching.

- If you do not specify this parameter:

  - If you specify the keyWord parameter, the search mode is set to LIKE.

  - If you do not specify the keyWord parameter, RRKeyWord and ValueKeyWord support fuzzy matching, and TypeKeyWord, Type, Line, and Status support exact matching.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the DNS record. Valid values:

Enable: The DNS record is enabled.

Disable: The DNS record is paused.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the DNS record. For more information, see:

<props="china">[DNS record types](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29805.html)</props>
<props="intl">[DNS record types](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/doc-detail/29805.htm)</props>

parameters.name: TypeKeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword for the record type. The search uses an exact match and is not case-sensitive.

parameters.name: ValueKeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword for the record value. The search uses a fuzzy match pattern and is not case-sensitive.
